description: Agent4Q is designed to analyze video content by extracting frame and subtitle data, assessing visuals and narratives for specific counts and predictions, conducting targeted web searches for contextual information, and delivering results in a structured format without additional commentary.

tools.name: VideoAnalysisTool
tools.description: Analyzes video frames to extract visual data and key metrics such as counts of objects or scenes.

tools.name: SubtitleExtractor
tools.description: Extracts subtitles from video files, allowing for textual analysis of the narrative content.

tools.name: ImageRecognitionAPI
tools.description: Identifies and classifies objects within video frames, providing insights into the content.

tools.name: WebSearchTool
tools.description: Performs targeted web searches to find contextual information, such as dates or relevant scientific data.

tools.name: DataFormatter
tools.description: Formats the output data into structured results, ensuring clarity and consistency in the presentation.
